name: PT Siantar Top Tbk
summary: PT Siantar Top Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells snacks in Indonesia. The company operates through Food Processing and Others segments. It offers rice, candies, coffee, crackers, instant noodles and snack noodles, pellets, vermicelli, biscuits, and wafers, as well as flour and seasoning products. The company provides its products under the Twistko, Tic Tic, Spix, Go Potato, Go!, Goriorio, Boyki, My Choco, Gemez Enaak, O'krimer, Maestro, Jaya Mie, Gemez, and Suki brand names. It also exports its products to Asia and the Middle East. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Sidoarjo, Indonesia. PT Siantar Top Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Shindo Tiara Tung…
